statement:
∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → a ≤ b → b-a ≤ 1 →
∀ f g h df dg dh : KdVPlan.Path, KdVPlan.XPath 0 a b f df → KdVPlan.XPath 0 a b g dg → KdVPlan.XPath 0 a b h dh →
KdVPlan.HB 0 (KdVPlan.tri a b f g h) (C*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b f df*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b g dg*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b h dh)
proof:
have hsrc := h_E003
obtain ⟨c, hc, hb⟩ := hsrc
let d := c*KdVPlan.csrc^2
have hd : 0 < d := mul_pos hc (sq_pos_of_pos (@yui_aux_0001 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013))
refine ⟨2*d, mul_pos (by norm_num) hd, ?_⟩
intro a b ha hab hba f g h df dg dh hf hg hh
have hbound := (@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 c a b f g h df dg dh (hb.1 0 a b le_rfl zero_le_one ha hab hba f g h df dg dh hf hg hh)).1
have hf0 : KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b f ≤ KdVPlan.Xnorm a b f df := le_add_of_nonneg_right ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
have hg0 : KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b g ≤ KdVPlan.Xnorm a b g dg := le_add_of_nonneg_right ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
have hh0 : KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b h ≤ KdVPlan.Xnorm a b h dh := le_add_of_nonneg_right ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
have hfn : KdVPlan.EssH (-KdVPlan.pstar) a b f ≤ KdVPlan.Xnorm a b f df :=
 (@yui_aux_0054 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 (-KdVPlan.pstar) 0 a b f (by norm_num [KdVPlan.pstar]) hf.2.1).2.trans hf0
have hx₁ := @yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b f df
have hx₂ := @yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b g dg
have hx₃ := @yui_aux_0056 T gamma R h_E003 h_T013 a b h dh
have hn₁ : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.EssH (-KdVPlan.pstar) a b f := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
have hn₂ : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b g := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
have hn₃ : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b h := ENNReal.toReal_nonneg
refine ⟨hbound.1, hbound.2.trans ?_⟩
change d*(b-a)*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b f df*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b g dg*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b h dh+
 d*KdVPlan.EssH (-KdVPlan.pstar) a b f*KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b g*KdVPlan.EssH 0 a b h ≤ _
calc
 _ ≤ d*1*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b f df*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b g dg*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b h dh+
 d*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b f df*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b g dg*KdVPlan.Xnorm a b h dh := by
  gcongr
 _ = _ := by ring
